approach.title: What a home can hold
approach.description: Four areas of life, each tied to a zone of the home and a planet in your chart. Calm comes first, because every other area rests on a settled mind.

pillars.title: Calm mind
pillars.description: Less stress and anxiety, steadier emotions, a home that lets you switch off.

pillars.title: Rest & health
pillars.description: Deeper sleep, a grounded bedroom, rooms that restore energy instead of draining it.

pillars.title: Family harmony
pillars.description: Fewer frictions, warmer shared spaces, a kitchen and living room that bring people together.

pillars.title: Career & growth
pillars.description: Focus, recognition and momentum, read from your 10th house and running dasha.

principle.label: Renting or already living there
principle.title: Change the energy, not the walls.
principle.imageAlt: Bright, uncluttered living room with natural light and indoor plants
principle.description: Rebuilding a house to fix vastu is costly and rarely necessary. Classical vastu offers corrections, and thoughtful interior styling does the rest:
items: Placement: move beds, desks, stoves and heavy furniture into supportive zones.
Light and colour: brighten the north-east and ground the south-west.
Clearing: remove clutter, broken items and blocked corners.
Living elements: bring in plants, natural materials and fresh air where they belong.

mandala.title: Vastu mandala
mandala.description: Select a direction to explore its traditional association and a practical way to think about that part of the home.

cells.label: North-west
cells.focus: Open air, gentle light and uncluttered circulation.

cells.label: North
cells.focus: Keep it light, ordered and focused for work and flow.

cells.label: North-east
cells.focus: Use natural light, spiritual objects and calm storage.

cells.label: West
cells.focus: Keep surfaces simple and support long-term habits.

cells.label: Centre
cells.focus: Keep open, light and uncluttered for everyday harmony.

cells.label: East
cells.focus: Use light, fresh air and active living rhythms.

cells.label: South-west
cells.focus: Use heavy furniture, warmth and restful materials.

cells.label: South
cells.focus: Keep it deliberate, balanced and low on chaos.

cells.label: South-east
cells.focus: Support the kitchen and shared rituals with warmth.

about.title: About Stella Space
about.description: Practical vastu for real homes and real lives, grounded in astrology without becoming rigid or theoretical.

glossary.name: Vastu
glossary.description: Directional balance, building energies and the way a home can hold your life without friction.

glossary.name: Kundali
glossary.description: Your birth chart, used to determine the areas of life most supported by your current home and timing.

glossary.name: Dasha
glossary.description: Planetary timing that tells us which rooms and actions matter most in the present season of life.

footer: Stella Space blends vastu, astrology and interiors into practical home guidance for clearer rooms, steadier habits and a home that supports growth.
